####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the model results and plot it 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../fun_figures/fun_breaks.R")
source("../fun_figures/fun_limits.R")
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Raw data 
```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds"))
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicbest.rds"))
```

# Define main analyses 
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Define models converging that have a sine function 
```{r}
df_converged <- filter(waic_df, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08"), mod_out == "imm") %>%
  # The function needs arguments reg (NA for cs and "reg_x" for csi) and multi (multi pat)
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod_name, "csi") ~ str_remove_all(mod_name, "csi_")), 
         multi = str_detect(pat, "multi"))
```

```{r}
# Extract covars coefficients
all_coefcovars <-readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefcovars.rds"))
# Extract random effects coefficients
all_coefre <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefre.rds"))
# Extract draws from the posterior for covars coefficients factors
all_samplecovarsfct <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescovarsfct.rds"))
all_coefrescor <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_coefrescor.rds"))
```

# Figure 4 =========================================================================================

# Prepare data 
```{r}
param_tidy_names <- data.frame(
  param = c("age", "sex", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "reg_2", "reg_6", 
            "vac_name_v1"),
  param_tidy = c("Age", "Sex (M)", "Time Last-vaccination to \nImmunogenicity", "Vaccine concentration",
  "Time 1st-vaccination to \n2nd-vaccination", "Time 2nd-vaccination to \n3rd-vaccination", 
  "Region (North)", "Region (Temperate)", "Vaccine")) %>%
  mutate(param_tidy = factor(param_tidy, levels = c(
    "Age", "Sex (M)", "Time Last-vaccination to \nImmunogenicity", 
    "Time 1st-vaccination to \n2nd-vaccination", "Time 2nd-vaccination to \n3rd-vaccination", 
    "Vaccine concentration", "Region (Temperate)", "Region (North)", "Vaccine")))

# Prepare covars 
datpl_l <- list()
# Data for not factors
datpl_l$nfct <- filter(all_coefcovars, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, 
                       !(param %in% c("Intercept", "reg_2", "reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6", "vac_name_v1"))) %>%
  left_join(param_tidy_names, by = join_by(param)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(est_ci95lo > 0 ~ "pos", est_ci95up < 0 ~ "neg"))
# Data from uvn models 
datpl_l$fct <- filter(all_coefcovars, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_best$mod_best,
                      param %in% c("Intercept", "reg_2", "reg_3", "reg_4", "reg_6", "vac_name_v1")) %>%
  left_join(param_tidy_names, by = join_by(param)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(est_ci95lo > 0 ~ "pos", est_ci95up < 0 ~ "neg"))
# Data from re 
datpl_l$re <- filter(all_coefre, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_best$mod_best) 
```

# Plot age, sex, time, time beween doses, time to serology, vaccine concentration
```{r}
col_sig <- c("orange", "#0D0887FF")
names(col_sig) <- c("pos", "neg")

pl_cov_l <- sapply(c("age", "sex", "time_vl_s1", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3", "vac_conc"), function(x) {
  filter(datpl_l$nfct, param == x) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = est, y = reorder(pat_tidy, est), color = sig)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey") + 
    geom_point() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = est_ci95lo, xend = est_ci95up)) + 
    facet_grid(~param_tidy, scales = "free") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_sig) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Estimate") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
          strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0))
}, simplify = FALSE)

pl_cov_l
```

# Plot region, vac name
```{r}
library(ggh4x)
pl_cov_l$reg <- filter(datpl_l$fct, str_detect(param, "reg")) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_clu, param_i = clu, param_i_tidy = clu_tidy), by = join_by(param_i)) %>%
  mutate(param_i_tidy = factor(param_i_tidy, levels = rev(levels(param_i_tidy)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = param_i_tidy, color = sig)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey") + 
    geom_point() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = est_ci95lo, xend = est_ci95up)) + 
    facet_nested(param_tidy+reorder(pat_tidy, est)~"Region", scales = "free", space = "free",
                 nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_sig) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Estimate") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
          strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0))

pl_cov_l$vac_name_v1 <- filter(datpl_l$fct, str_detect(param, "vac_name_v1")) %>%
  left_join(rename(tidy_names_clu, param_i = clu, param_i_tidy = clu_tidy), by = join_by(param_i)) %>%
  mutate(param_i_tidy = factor(param_i, levels = c("dtpw", "strep7", "strep13", "strep11"),
                               labels = c("DTPw", "Pfizer-7","Pfizer-13",  "GSK-11"))) %>%
  mutate(param_tidy = case_when(param_i == "dtpw" ~ "Vaccine \n(DTPa)",
                                str_detect(param_i, "strep") ~ "Vaccine \n(GSK-10)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = param_i_tidy, color = sig)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey") + 
    geom_point() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = est_ci95lo, xend = est_ci95up)) + 
    facet_nested(param_tidy+pat_tidy~"Vaccine", scales = "free", space = "free",
               nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_sig) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Estimate") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          #strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
          strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0))
```

```{r}
dat_rescor <- all_coefrescor %>%
  filter(mod_name == "base") %>%
  mutate(multipat = if_else(pat %in% c("multi_ipv", "multi_strep", "multi_men", "multi_pertua"), 
                            "Uni pathogen", "Multi pathogen")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(pat, "multi_strep")) %>%
  mutate(patuni_tidy1 = case_when(
    patuni_tidy1 %in% c("Rubella", "Varicella", "Mumps", "Measles", "Tetanus", "Diphteria") ~ substr(patuni_tidy1, 1, 3),
    patuni_tidy1 == "N. meningitidis C" ~ "N. men C",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Pertussis (A) PT" ~ "Per PT",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Pertussis (W) PT" ~ "Per PT",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Pertussis (A) PRN" ~ "Per PRN",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Pertussis (A) FHA" ~ "Per FHA",
    patuni_tidy1 == "N. meningitidis A" ~ "N. men A",
    patuni_tidy1 == "H. influenzae B" ~ "H. inf B",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Polio (I) 1" ~ "Pol 1",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Polio (I) 2" ~ "Pol 2",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Polio (I) 3" ~ "Pol 3",
    .default = patuni_tidy1 ),
    patuni_tidy2 = case_when(
    patuni_tidy2 %in% c("Rubella", "Varicella", "Mumps", "Measles", "Tetanus", "Diphteria") ~ substr(patuni_tidy2, 1, 3),
    patuni_tidy2 == "N. meningitidis C" ~ "N. men C",
    patuni_tidy2 == "N. meningitidis A" ~ "N. men A",
    patuni_tidy2 == "H. influenzae B" ~ "H. inf B",
    patuni_tidy2 == "Pertussis (A) PT" ~ "Per PT",
    patuni_tidy1 == "Pertussis (W) PT" ~ "Per PT",
    patuni_tidy2 == "Pertussis (A) PRN" ~ "Per PRN",
    patuni_tidy2 == "Pertussis (A) FHA" ~ "Per FHA",
    patuni_tidy2 == "Polio (I) 1" ~ "Pol 1",
    patuni_tidy2 == "Polio (I) 2" ~ "Pol 2",
    patuni_tidy2 == "Polio (I) 3" ~ "Pol 3",
    .default = patuni_tidy2 ),
    
    ) %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = str_remove_all(pat_tidy, "multi")) %>%
  mutate(pat2lab_tidy = paste0(patuni_tidy1, "-", patuni_tidy2)) 

dat_rescor %>%
  expand(nesting(imm_name1, imm_name2), pat_tidy) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rescor, y = pat2lab_tidy)) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey") + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = rescor_ci95lo, xend = rescor_ci95up)) +
  facet_nested(reorder(pat_tidy, rescor)~"Correlation", 
               scales = "free", space = "free", nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE) +
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        legend.position = "none")

dat_rescor %>%
  select(patuni_tidy1, patuni_tidy2, pat_tidy, rescor) %>%
  group_by(pat_tidy) %>%
  expand(patuni_tidy1, patuni_tidy2)


pl_cov_l$mvn <- dat_rescor %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = patuni_tidy2, y = patuni_tidy1, fill = rescor)) +
  geom_tile() + 
  scale_x_discrete("") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  facet_nested_wrap(reorder(pat_tidy, rescor)~., scales= "free", ncol = 8) + 
  scale_fill_viridis("Correlation")
```

# Figures with the real data =======================================================================

# Read in raw data 
```{r}
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v3)_s08.*", "\\1", 
                    str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE))
# Combine data for selected pathogens
datsel_l <- bind_rows(dat_l[pat_sel], .id = "pat")
```

# Plot continous variables 
```{r}
pl_covars_all <- sapply(c("age", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3"), function(x) {
# Obtain coefficients
datcoef <- datpl_l$nfct %>%
  filter(param == x) %>%
  # Add intercept 
  left_join(datpl_l$fct %>%
              filter(param == "Intercept") %>%
              rename(int = est, int_ci95lo = est_ci95lo, int_ci95up = est_ci95up) %>%
              select(mod, starts_with("int"), dat, reg, multi), 
            by = join_by(mod, dat, reg, multi))

# Obtain new values
param_grids <- datsel_l %>%
  filter(pat %in% datcoef$pat) %>%
  rename(param_x = x) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  reframe(param_x = seq(min(param_x), max(param_x), length.out = 100)) %>%
  left_join(select(datcoef, pat, starts_with("est"), starts_with("int"), sig, pat_tidy),
            by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  mutate(pred = exp(int + (est*param_x)),
         pred_ci95lo = exp(int_ci95lo + (est_ci95lo*param_x)),
         pred_ci95up = exp(int_ci95up + (est_ci95up*param_x)))

pl <- datsel_l %>%
  filter(pat %in% datcoef$pat) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(param_grids, pat, est), by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  rename(param_x = x) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = param_x, y = imm_val_s1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.01)  +
  geom_line(data = param_grids, aes(y = pred, color = sig), size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = param_grids, aes(ymin = pred_ci95lo, ymax = pred_ci95up, y = NULL, fill = sig), 
              color = "transparent", alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(unique(datcoef$param_tidy), breaks = fun_breaks, limits = fun_limits, expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_log10("Immunogenicity (log)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_sig) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_sig) + 
  facet_wrap(~reorder(pat_tidy, -est), scales = "free", ncol = 5) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

  nreg <- length(unique(datcoef$pat)) / 5
  ggsave(pl, width = 8, height = 2*nreg,
         file = paste0("../figures/modres_covars/covars_", x, ".pdf"))
  return(pl)
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

# Plot distributions
```{r}
pl_covars_all <- sapply(c("age", "time_vl_s1", "vac_conc", "time_v1_v2", "time_v2_v3"), function(x) {
# Obtain coefficients
datcoef <-filter(datpl_l$nfct, param == x) 

pl <- datsel_l %>%
  filter(pat %in% datcoef$pat) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(datcoef, pat, est, sig), by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  rename(param_x = x) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = param_x, color = sig)) +
  geom_density()  +
  scale_x_continuous(unique(datcoef$param_tidy)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_sig) + 
  facet_grid(reorder(pat_tidy, -est)~., scales = "free") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")


pl <- datsel_l %>%
  filter(pat %in% datcoef$pat) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(datcoef, pat, est, sig), by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  rename(param_x = x) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = param_x, color = sig, group = pat)) +
  geom_density()  +
  scale_x_continuous(unique(datcoef$param_tidy)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_sig) + 
  facet_grid(reorder(pat_tidy, -est)~.) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

  nreg <- length(unique(datcoef$pat)) / 5
  ggsave(pl, width = 8, height = 2*nreg,
         file = paste0("../figures/modres_covars/covarsdens_", x, ".pdf"))
  return(pl)
}, simplify = FALSE)
```
